meta.title: translationCore Desktop | Bible translation workspace
meta.description: A free, open-source workspace to draft, check, align, and share Bible translations, with unfoldingWord resources built in. Works offline.

hero.h1: An end-to-end workspace for Bible translation
hero.p2: Draft, check, align, and share a translation in one app. Works offline.
hero.span: New: translationCore v4 Beta · Windows, Mac, Linux

screenshot.p: Translate mode, with notes and source text beside you.

modes.p: translationNotes, translationWords, translationQuestions, translationAcademy, ULT, and UST work together in one workspace, so you can understand Scripture and translate it accurately and clearly.
modes.label: Understand, Translate, Check
modes.figcaption: Understand. Read the passage and its notes before you start.
modes.figcaption2: Translate. Draft beside the source text, a section at a time.
modes.figcaption3: Check. Review each item against the original, then mark it valid.

checking.h2: Everything your team needs, in one place
checking.p: Write a section, then place verse numbers.
checking.p2: See Greek or Hebrew next to the ULT and UST.
checking.p3: Notes, words, comments, and alignment suggestions.
checking.p4: Check key terms, then align to the original.
checking.p5: Translate and check stories. Export Markdown or PDF.
checking.p6: Export aligned USFM, a Scripture Burrito, or PDF, or share to Door43.

how.span: Start a project, or import one.
how.span2: Draft a section at a time.
how.alt: Switch between ULT, UST, and the Greek source
how.figcaption: Switch between ULT, UST, and the Greek source
how.alt2: Draft a whole section, then place verse numbers
how.figcaption2: Draft a whole section, then place verse numbers

btservant.label: BT Servant
btservant.h2: Have a translation question? Ask BT Servant.
btservant.p: Get guidance grounded in trusted resources, in your language.

downloads.p3: Signed by unfoldingWord. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, check that the publisher is unfoldingWord, then choose Run anyway.
downloads.p5: Intel Macs are not supported yet. This build is not signed yet, so macOS may block it. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway, or Control-click the installer and choose Open. It asks for an administrator password.
downloads.p8: New: translationCore v4 Beta. Test with copies of your projects and keep backups.
downloads.p9: Need help? See the help site or the release notes.

previous.p: The previous version stays available until v4 Beta is stable.
